newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK-ROTHMANS LEADS TRADE,ZCCM JUMPS.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK-ROTHMANS LEADS TRADE,ZCCM JUMPS.

text.p: Activity increased on the Lusaka
stock exchange in the week ended February 14, exchange officials
said.
They said traded volume rose to 3,051,384 shares valued at
130,170,366 kwacha from 2,395,912 shares valued at 37,405,810
kwacha the previous week.
Rothmans remained steady at 32 kwacha in a traded volume of
1,881,792 shares valued at 60,217,344 kwacha.
Chilanga Cement remained steady at 56 kwacha and saw
1,023,000 shares valued at 58,288,000 kwacha exchanging hands.
Farmers House fell five kwacha to end the week at 175 kwacha
in a traded volume of 59,128 shares worth 10,347,950 kwacha
while Zambia Sugar fell 1.5 kwacha to end the week at 12.5
kwacha and saw 87,430 shares worth 1,209,020 kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) gained 1,700 kwacha
to end the week at 3,600, its twelve months high, in a traded
volume of 30 shares valued at 108,000 kwacha.
Exchange officials said the 89 percent increase in the ZCCM
share price was a delayed response to the much higher prices on
the Paris bourse.
